items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 21 August 2026 at 4:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the Atlantic extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Northerly 3 to 5, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area, becoming north or northwest 2 to 4 in all waters this afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5 in western waters this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 3 to 5, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area at first, decreasing 2 or 3 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
